description: See which people are live right now and can take a live chat. Free; nobody is notified. Set wait_seconds to wait (up to 50 seconds) for someone to come online. Use get_quote with a humanId to see their price before connect_human.

specialization.description: Optional: only people with this specialization.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds (0-50) for someone to be live. Default 0.

name: who_is_live
